purpose: classify the observed official asynchronous evaluator variability before any PI2N scientific rollout; never select a checkpoint or policy from these outcomes

runtime.evaluator: official DexJoCo asynchronous evaluator with the already-versioned cross-episode future-chunk quarantine

randomness.environment: official evaluator _set_seed(8), then ten sequential resets in a fresh evaluator process per replicate
randomness.inference_worker: official evaluator _set_seed(8) in each fresh inference process
randomness.policy_sampling: OpenPI Policy starts from jax.random.key(0) on each fresh server and advances once per infer request
randomness.reason: the official websocket API exposes no per-episode policy RNG reset; adding one would change sampling semantics

fixed_observation_fixture.definition: episode zero's first inference request in each fresh model/replicate process
fixed_observation_fixture.input_identity: canonical SHA256 over every policy payload field after removing diagnostic-only episode/reset keys
fixed_observation_fixture.output_identity: SHA256 over float32 action chunk bytes
requirements: the first input identity is equal across all models and replicates
within each model the first action identity is equal across all three fresh-server replicates
fixed_observation_fixture.interpretation: tests fixed-input/fixed-request-position inference only; does not require full rollout outcomes to be identical

episode_identity.reset_identity: SHA256 over initial mjSTATE_INTEGRATION float64 bytes plus official processed state float64 bytes
episode_identity.requirement: the ordered ten reset identities are identical for every model and replicate

classification.R_A_STRUCTURAL_ERROR: any reset identity/order mismatch, failed runtime gate, non-finite/malformed action, target leakage, or unquarantined cross-episode action contamination
classification.R_B_LEGAL_RANDOMNESS_COMPARABLE: all structural/fairness gates pass; outcome disagreement may remain and is reported without treating it as a success-rate effect
classification.R_C_UNEXPLAINED_MODEL_UNFAIRNESS: all reset identities match but any model has model-specific infrastructure failure, missing episode, altered timeout/replan semantics, or lacks the same fixed-observation opportunity
classification.cross_episode_quarantine: count and report every already-versioned stale future-chunk discard; a discard is not executed and does not by itself create an unquarantined contamination

retry.otherwise: retain interrupted attempt and restart the entire model-replicate cohort; accept the first complete clean cohort
